title: React Architecture & Component Best Practices
keyTechniques: Keep components focused, modular, and single-purpose
Extract state management and side effects into custom hooks (e.g., useTasks, useAuth) to separate logic from UI rendering
Treat state as immutable; always use updater functions or spread operators when mutating objects or arrays
Use proper keys when rendering lists (prefer unique IDs over array indices)
avoid: Do not mutate state directly (e.g., state.push(newItem) or state.value = x)
Do not perform side effects or data fetching directly in component render bodies; use useEffect or custom hooks
Do not nest component function definitions inside another component's render body
